# The changes the setup makes to brcmfmac43602-pcie.bin (linux-firmware's
# 7.35.177.61, sha256 bf4cfc23ee952a3d82ef33a0f5f87853201c98f1bed034876a910f354f37862d),
# on the machine it is installed on. The result has sha256
# b34c409d5cec3c9c3b233db044dc852f796ea7b9371199568a5db17695ecd40b. The setup
# checks both hashes, and every old byte before it writes.
#
# One change per line: file offset, the bytes there now, the bytes it writes (hex).

# Bluetooth setup: the sub-type 3 branch serves sub-type 5 (cmp r6,#3 -> #5)
0x35ec4 03 05

# Bluetooth setup: PHY register 0x40a bit 8 cleared, as macOS does, in place of 0x417
0x35ece 174143f6f072 0a4140f20012

# Bluetooth setup: chip control 0x1400010 under mask 0x1400090, as macOS sets it
0x36000 040000010c0000 10004001900040

# front-end table: board sub-type 5 takes the branch that loads the tables below
0x6fa4e 03 10

# front-end table: Apple's three tables for this board (X100CidreES2 c0, c1, c2)
0x7fe2d
